edits.current: Law 2466 of 2025 art. 64 para. 2, verbatim: 'Las partes podran acordar por escrito la mensualizacion de los intereses sobre las cesantias, pagando al trabajador el 1% del salario base de liquidacion compuesto por el salario mensual sumado al auxilio de transporte en los casos en que a este hubiere lugar'. Three engine consequences. First, it needs a written agreement, so the flag is per contract. Second, the base is the monthly salary plus the transport allowance where payable, not the accumulated balance - so the monthly route and the annual route give different figures and the draft decree confirms the 1% monthly 'correspondiente al doce por ciento (12%) anual previsto en la ley'. Third, the draft decree sets the payment window: 'dentro del mes calendario siguiente al de su causacion'. The MinTrabajo draft decree amending Decree 1072 of 2015 (proyecto_decreto_cesantias_2026.pdf) is not in force. Build the field and keep the feature switched OFF until the decree is published AND the MinSalud PILA regulation exists.
edits.proposed: Law 2466 of 2025 art. 64 para. 2, verbatim: 'Las partes podran acordar por escrito la mensualizacion de los intereses sobre las cesantias, pagando al trabajador el 1% del salario base de liquidacion compuesto por el salario mensual sumado al auxilio de transporte en los casos en que a este hubiere lugar'. Two engine consequences. First, it needs a written agreement, so the flag is per contract. Second, the base is the monthly salary plus the transport allowance where payable, not the accumulated balance - so the monthly route and the annual route give different figures. The paragraph applies under the written agreement alone: the 1% is paid to the employee, does not go through PILA and needs no further regulation. It sets no payment date of its own.
edits.why: Monthly interest (par. 2) is law in force with no PILA or regulation condition; the switched-OFF condition and the draft-decree references belonged to the monthly advance (par. 1), removed from the spec on 2026-10-23.

edits.current: Compute 12% per annum on the 31 December balance, pro-rated on days over 360, and PAY IT TO THE EMPLOYEE DIRECTLY DURING JANUARY of the following year - never to the fund and never in February. Liquidate no interest on interest. Where a WRITTEN agreement exists under Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 64 par. 2, pay instead 1% monthly of the monthly base (salary + transport allowance), within the calendar month following accrual per the draft decree. Evidence the payment - failure costs an indemnity equal to the interest owed, once only, under Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1.
